date_note: Date of the KVKK Board decision on the notice, as relayed by Log.com.tr; the breach itself began on 15 November and was detected on 16 November according to the notice.
geo_basis: country as stated (Turkey); city not stated in the page read
title: KVKK notice says Yeditepe University reported a data breach via a flaw in a component behind its internet-facing POS application
summary: Log.com.tr reports that Turkey's data protection authority KVKK published a breach notice for Yeditepe University after a Board decision dated 25 November. The notice says the breach began on 15 November, was detected on 16 November and came from a vulnerability in a component running behind the university's internet-facing POS application. It says employees and students are affected, the number of people is not yet known and the investigation continues.
plain: Turkey's data protection authority says Yeditepe University reported a breach affecting employees and students. The number of people is not yet known and the investigation continues.
exec: A Turkish university has reported a breach of staff and student data to the regulator; the scope is not yet known.

validation.note: Only Log.com.tr read, relaying the KVKK notice; KVKK's own page could not be loaded. Gazetememur.com (26 Nov, 00:55) said no registered breach notification for Yeditepe existed in KVKK records at the time of writing; it gave no details.
